elements.note: Drawn as a standalone 1:20 detail to the right of the table, with no level row of its own. Same section and steel as C1 at pier level.

warnings: COLUMN SCHEDULE. Rows are levels read bottom-up -- ระดับตอม่อ/ฐานราก, then พื้นชั้นที่ 1, then ระดับอะเส/พื้นชั้นที่ 2. An UP-ARROW in a cell means 'same as the storey below, continuing upward'; those cells are recorded with a continuation field and no section, rather than by silently copying the section down, so a consumer can tell a drawn section from an inherited one.

*** THE C1 CELL AT อะเส LEVEL IS SPLIT IN TWO, and the two halves disagree on purpose: the left half is a DASH (the column stops -- the single-storey part of the house) and the right half is an UP-ARROW (the column continues to floor 2). No other cell in the table is split. Both halves are recorded as separate C1 entries at that level; treating C1 as one column at this level would lose the distinction. ***

SECTIONS SHRINK GOING UP while bar counts mostly do not: C2 goes 250 -> 200 keeping 4 Ø16, and C3 goes 300 -> 200 keeping all 8 Ø16 before dropping to 4 Ø16 above floor 2. The 200 x 200 C3 with eight Ø16 and a double tie is the most congested cage in the schedule.

Tie shapes are drawn, not named: a plain square outline for the single-tie columns and a square-plus-diamond octagon for the '2ป.' columns. Recorded in Thai in stirrup.shape as ปลอกเดี่ยวสี่เหลี่ยม / ปลอกสี่เหลี่ยม + ปลอกทแยง (2 ปลอก).
C1 and CX use ป.Ø6@0.175 ม. -- an unusual 175 mm spacing that every other column on the sheet replaces with 0.20 ม.

CX SITS OUTSIDE THE TABLE with no level assigned. It is the extra off-grid column seen on the S-03 floor plan at the head of the stair opening. Its section and steel are identical to C1 at pier level, so it is most likely a C1 by another name, but the sheet does not say so and no level row is given -- flagged rather than merged.
The schedule covers C1, C2, C3 and CX. The steel posts CS1 (S-05) and CS2 (S-04) are NOT in this table -- they are sized in their own sheets' หมายเหตุ blocks as 2C sections.
